subject: 英语
source: 人教版(PEP)小学英语（三年级起点，3-6年级）语法与功能句型体系
original_text: 现在进行时表示现在或现阶段正在进行的动作。结构：be(am/is/are)+动词-ing。标志词：now, look, listen, It's... o'clock。句型：What are you doing? — I am reading a book. Look! She is singing.
key_points: 变-ing：一般加ing，去e加ing，双写末辅
formulas: 示例：Look! He is running. / They are eating lunch.
cautions: ①be 动词与主语一致（I am, he is, they are）；②动词-ing 拼写（make→making 去e，run→running 双写，swim→swimming 双写）；③now/look/listen 提示下未用进行时；④be 动词漏写。
